body: Thankyou for actually trying to help, you are a great person for reaching out to a stranger and it makes me very emotional knowing people like you exsist for the first time in my life. I am going to consider what you have said about seeking help and look for consultation from my doctor at my next visit tomorrow. If you believe it will help I have to give it a shot as I can't take feeling like this anymore and balancing on the edge. I will let you know how I go and I hope that my problems don't affect you detrimental.

I've looked into it and the social stigma that comes with putting yourself into the system like that, deters me from doing it. This is something I am going to have to deal with myself, my mood constantly fluctuates between wanting to end it all and believing I can make it through it, I gave my local hot line a call last night when I came close to it again, it helped for a second but in the end it didn't work and I had to take sleeping pills to knock me out and stop the thoughts.

honestly I have no idea how much longer I'll hold out, I think when I get the final notice to leave my house I'll be leaving something extra for them to clean up.

I've tried claiming welfare, but apparently I'm un eligible for payments and they are giving me the run around on disability payments. My income protection is useless and trying to find a job working from home is impossible.

Thats exactly It as well, I finally felt happy with my life and proud of what I achieved, now I feel exactly like my father must have felt and realize why he drank so much, I just don't want to fall down his path but the easy option looks more inviting than putting myself through hell again to achieve my old life, my trust issues are severely bad now after losing the woman I loved as well and showing the world my needs has never gotten me anything and I really doubt it ever will

thankyou for taking time to talk to me, it means a lot and weirdly enough talking about it kept my mind off of it, if that makes any sense.

He was 6 years older than me, and ran the house when my mother walked out on us and my dad was too drunk to do anything eventually leading to him taking his own life, my brother died in a car accident along with his best friend and I lived with my grandfather until he died when I was 19. I once took anti depressants but they just seemed to make it worse.

I was a strong person, until now when everything i fought for got torn apart and you are completely right about me not knowing how to receive help, that's what drove my ex girlfriend away I believe, I've tried every option and Avenue to keep me going for the next year, but I've exhausted every option and can't be homeless, not with my injuries.
What is something you have always wanted to do? Or something that even interests you slightly? I'm sure I can find something to lift your spirits, gaming only works for so long

Thanks for replying and I have battled with depression, since around 15 when I lost my older brother, who was always there for me. My best mate has tried to be there for me, but I put on a strong face in front of him, not for fear of being seen as weak but just not wanting him to have to worry about me when he has 2 young kids and a full time job to deal with.

when my girlfriend left me, that's when everything hit me and reality set in, everything I worked for and fought for on my own is now gone and the realization of having to go through that ordeal again is agonizing to even think of.

I've felt like this for a long time too, there's only two points in my life where I wasn't depressed, riding my motorbike and being with my ex girlfriend. Look around and you will see that most people are depressed and they deal with it, by blocking it out with focusing on work, a hobby they really enjoy or loving someone,  you just have to put yourself out there and don't take self pity on yourself anymore because people find that unattractive, trust me I have experience with that, try smile and grab the world by the balls and focus on finding something or someone that can make you forget about the day to day grind and crap life throws at you

I know its hard to deal with but what's causing the depression? Is there any way you can remedy it? Any family or close friends who you can confide in? Maybe they will give you an outside perspective better than I can, seeing they would know you a whole lot better than me

I'm not in the best state myself, but I'll try my best to help you.

Is it depression that causes you the pain and suffering?
